system:
Decide one routing question: are the still images actual first/last frames, or content references redrawn into a new scene? Interpret the complete user request semantically, not a keyword list. An actual opening frame selects i2va, an actual closing frame l2va, two opening/closing frames fl2va. Identity, environment, style, storyboard or a character appearing in a new scene selects ref2va.
Return interpretation anchor_instruction for a clear instruction to make an input the actual frame; content_reference_instruction for a clear content-reference request; two_subjects only for two pictures depicting distinct things which must appear together; ambiguous if neither meaning is specified. Ambiguous selects ref2va while recording that soft reference conditioning cannot guarantee an exact frame. Return anchor_instruction_present true only when the user actually requests anchoring, with source_quote quoting that instruction exactly. Otherwise source_quote may be empty.
When the schema pins declared_reference and mode, do NOT reroute: the caller's declared responsibilities govern. Only audit whether the prose conflicts by asking for an actual frame. Report anchor_instruction_present and its exact quote; never report a conflict just because an image is attached. A reference role with normal appearance-in-scene wording has no override. Caller roles/provenance outrank ambiguous prose. confidence is your own interpretation confidence; the host records it separately from the deterministic compatibility routing policy. Never invent observations about unread media. Return JSON only.

cards.summary: A dark, cinematic multi-panel character reference sheet for a lone adult figure in black tactical clothing, featuring a rainy night hero image plus turnaround and detail views.

subjects.descriptor: Adult character shown in multiple reference views
attributes: shaved-side short dark hair with a small tied bun at the back
black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and buckle details
pose: in the hero panel, stands upright with arms at sides and head turned to the viewer's left
in the turnaround panels, stands facing the camera, in profile, and with the back to the camera
in the face close-up, looks toward the camera with a neutral expression

cards.style: Photorealistic dark cinematic character concept and reference sheet, desaturated with warm accent lights.
cards.characterisation: A lean adult with East Asian features, shaved-side dark hair tied at the back, a scar through one eyebrow, and an all-black tactical outfit.
